result.document_summary: A page of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 2, Administrative Code) covering city public-works information, real-property acquisition, procurement and contracting, and design-build contracts, with no residential rental provisions.
result.notes: This part of the document contains only city government procurement and contracting provisions (Municipal Code Chapter 2, Article 2, Divisions 31-33). Although the source URL references San Diego's prohibition of anti-competitive automated rent price fixing (§ 98.1103), the text in this part does not include any algorithmic rent-setting provisions or any other rule in the six in-scope categories, so no rules were extracted.
